items.title: fix(agents): await auth publication before nested runtime admission
items.summary: fix(agents): await auth publication before nested runtime admission Join the existing configured-owner refresh before validating an explicitly captured plugin generation. Preserve abort, lifetime, deadlock and borrowed-generation authority checks. Count actual inference frames separately from native connection warmups in the quota fixture while checking credentials on every request. Reproduced scheduled-main failures: 13 fallback, 3 quota-recovery and 34 cancellation/lifetime/supersession cases now pass. Core and UI-e2e types, scoped lint, guards and fresh managed review passed. Quota teardown separately left stopped synthetic child processes after its Gateway escalation; those task-owned processes were cleaned up and the shutdown ownership defect remains under investigation.

items.title: fix(ui): retain Files action after header reparenting
items.summary: fix(ui): retain Files action after header reparenting The Lit sidebar hosts the Files button outside the Solid delegated event root. Attach its click listener directly and retire it with the component, following the existing hosted-action contract. Reproduced the failing three-case browser suite on main. All three pass after repair in 22.843s; 41 owner tests pass in 5.985s and the actual moved-button regression fails before repair. Types, lint, guards and fresh managed review passed. Inspected before/after proof: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169025#issuecomment-6109635510
